# A law through coupling that changes along the run

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-law-through-changing-coupling-along-one-run` · **superseded** · theorem · F11 · [record](a-law-through-changing-coupling-along-one-run.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where what a formation depends on forms and dissolves along a run, the law at what it couples into on each occasion and the law at the coupling of one moment agree where nothing it depends on changes; otherwise neither gives the other.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With dependences read off the configuration, two configurations are alike in what a formation couples into when the levels at each, through the dependence it has there, admit it alike and the conditions it observes stand alike. This is an equivalence, so some process going alike in it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where the occasions it couples alike, by the same move, lead to occasions it couples alike. Fixed conditions are the instance. (`Becoming.Dependence.AdmitsAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.AlikeAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.alikeAt_equivalence`, `Becoming.Dependence.conditions_alikeAt_iff`, `Becoming.Run.consistent_conditions_iff`, `Becoming.Run.law_through_dependence_iff`)
2. Along a run this is the relation between two steps each read through its own step's dependence. Web.AlikeThrough read at one step, between the levels standing at two steps, is the coupling with the dependence of that step held fixed; where the dependences at the two steps compared are that step's, it is the changing coupling. (`Becoming.Web.AlikeAcross`, `Becoming.Dependence.alikeAt_iff_alikeAcross`, `Becoming.Dependence.fixedAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.alikeThrough_iff_fixedAt`, `Becoming.Web.admits_own_iff`, `Becoming.Web.alikeAcross_iff_alikeThrough`)
3. Consistency reads a relation only on the run's configurations up to the step, so where a formation's dependences up to it are those of one step, the run is consistent under the changing coupling exactly where it is under the coupling fixed at that step. (`Becoming.Dependence.SameFor`, `Becoming.Dependence.admitsAt_fixedAt_iff`, `Becoming.Dependence.Unchanged`, `Becoming.Run.consistentUnder_congr`, `Becoming.Run.consistent_unchanged_iff`)
4. In Changing, one level rising by one each step, the process is determined. A dependence dissolving across the first step leaves the run consistent at every step under the changing coupling, and inconsistent at step 2 under the coupling fixed at the start. A dependence forming across the first step leaves the coupling fixed at the start consistent at every step, and the changing coupling inconsistent at step 3. (`Becoming.Changing.process`, `Becoming.Changing.run`, `Becoming.Changing.determined`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving`, `Becoming.Changing.forming`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolves`, `Becoming.Changing.forms`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_not_admits_zero`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_admits_succ`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_consistent`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_fixed_inconsistent`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_admits_zero`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_not_admits_one`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_admits_three`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_inconsistent`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_fixed_consistent`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_no_law`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_fixed_no_law`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Dependences are read off the configuration (Dependence of Becoming.Dependence); what a formation observes is fixed. For the criterion, the relation is the coupling, an equivalence. The witness is a one-level process. No axiom.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Observation that changes along the run is not treated; what a formation observes is fixed, as in Becoming.Testing.
- A dependence not read off the configuration (a Web whose requirements change with the step alone) is not treated here.
- Which dependences an actual formation forms along an unfolding, or how many steps settle whether a law at its coupling holds.
- The criterion is G4's applied to a new equivalence; what it adds is the relation through changing dependence, its bridges and the comparison with the fixed coupling.
- **Counterexample:** Neither law gives the other where dependences change: Changing (dissolving_consistent with dissolving_fixed_inconsistent; forming_fixed_consistent with forming_inconsistent). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/history/becoming/Becoming/LawThroughChangingCoupling.lean)

### Correspondence

The chapter's open programme (section 8.2, Selection, causes and experiment) named "the criterion through coupling that changes along the run", which a-law-through-coupling-along-one-run left in does_not_show. Ren, 18 October 2026: "you have permission now, please see what else is there to do - keep pushing the frontier till finishing"; 19 October: "continue" (provenance, not warrant); the AI chose the item. Reading (the AI's): a law at a formation's coupling along a course is a law at the coupling it has on each occasion; reading the course through the dependence of one moment can find a law its own coupling does not carry, or miss one it does.

**Law family:** A law along one run (lead: [a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run](a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run.md)). Under an equivalence, a law admits a run's steps up to a step exactly where steps alike under it, by the same move, end alike, and failure persists. The lead states it once; the law through what a formation couples into and the law through coupling that changes along the run were recorded first, are superseded by the lead and are its readings.
